userObservation.uhdSmoothnessConcern: Intermittent, not consistently reproducible by the user

changes.textureSurfaceHandoff: Release affected codec only for an actual Surface identity change; duplicate Surface notifications retain codec and consumed keyframe
changes.formatAndDrmChange: Affected TextureView codec reuse returns REUSE_RESULT_NO with DISCARD_REASON_WORKAROUND; Media3 drains then reinitializes instead of unsafe flush/reconfiguration
changes.realtekDetection: Explicit OMX.realtek prefix independently of OEM brand, with hardware/software and texture gates retained
changes.uhdIsolation: Learned Realtek synchronous profile is keyed by source id and decoder; selecting another source restores its Media3 default queue even with the same player, decoder and UHD format
retained: Animation and stable per-player video view
Video readiness waits for first frame

regression.before: Same final surface and input-format regression tests against the original 1.0.20 renderer: four failures across API28/35
regression.after: All tests pass, including duplicate output identity, actual vendor surface replacement, real Media3 onInputFormatChanged drain action and source-isolated queue factory dispatch

limitations: No physical TCL or Ugoos playback test; no claim of measured TV smoothness or confirmed absence of looping frames on hardware.
Robolectric controls codec adapters while executing the actual Media3 renderer and controller. It cannot reproduce the Realtek driver itself.
Provider BOX HLS/TS bytes remain unavailable; this release does not prove that stream is valid or supported by the device.
